sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Geodynamo Theory**: The primary source of Earth's magnetic field is the **self-sustaining dynamo** operating in the liquid outer core, driven by thermal and compositional convection of molten iron-nickel.
• **Magnetic Dipole & Axis**: The magnetic axis is currently tilted at an angle of approximately **11 to 11.5 degrees** relative to Earth's rotational (geographic) axis.
• **Magnetosphere**: The region surrounding the Earth dominated by its magnetic field, which traps charged particles in the **Van Allen Radiation Belts**.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: Surface magnetic field intensity ranges from roughly **25,000 to 65,000 nanoteslas (nT)**, being weakest near the equator and strongest at the magnetic poles.

items.title: Major Geographical Distribution / Regional Hubs
items.content:
• **South Atlantic Anomaly (SAA)**: A vast region where Earth's inner Van Allen radiation belt comes closest to the Earth's surface, causing high energetic particle flux and posing hazards to low-Earth-orbit satellites.
• **Magnetic Equator**: An imaginary line circling the Earth where the magnetic field is strictly horizontal (zero inclination), passing through southern India (Thumba near Trivandrum).

items.title: Challenges, Reforms & Forward Strategy
items.content:
• **Geomagnetic Secular Variation**: Rapid drift of the magnetic North Pole towards Siberia poses calibration challenges for modern aviation, marine navigation, and smartphone compasses.
• **Space Weather Monitoring**: Expanding observational networks (like Aditya-L1 and ground observatories) to mitigate disruptions in power grids, satellite communications, and GPS systems.

items.title: Mnemonic for Magnetic Elements (Declination, Inclination, Intensity)
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: "Don't Ignore Intensity"
• **Decoded Meaning**: **D**eclination, **I**nclination, **I**ntensity are the three primary components needed to fully define Earth's magnetic field at any point.
• **Prelims Exam Value**: Instantly eliminates incorrect options asking for complete geomagnetic vector components.

items.title: Retention Rule of Thumb
items.content: • **Core Formula / Rule**: Inclination is ZERO at the equator (flat/horizontal) and NINETY at the poles (standing straight up/vertical).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often states that the Magnetic North Pole coincides with the Geographic North Pole, or that it remains stationary. Both are false—the magnetic pole is currently located in the Arctic Ocean/Siberia region and moves continuously due to core fluid dynamics.
Mains Value Addition: Emphasize how Earth's magnetic field acts as a planetary shield without which atmospheric stripping by solar wind (similar to Mars) would have rendered Earth uninhabitable.

keyTakeaways: Earth's magnetic field is generated by convective currents of molten iron-nickel in the liquid outer core via the geodynamo mechanism.
The magnetic field is fully defined by three elements: Magnetic Declination, Magnetic Inclination, and Total Intensity.
Geomagnetic reversals recorded in oceanic crustal rocks provide conclusive proof of seafloor spreading and plate tectonics.
